HEX, RGB, and HSL color converter with contrast checker

Convert any color between HEX, RGB, and HSL in an instant with a live preview that updates as you type, and check text color contrast against the background color under WCAG to get a clear pass or fail result for each AA and AAA level. This tool runs entirely in your browser, and no value is sent to any server or external service, so you can use it with confidence in any project. Start by entering the hexadecimal value in the dedicated field, or enter red, green, and blue values, or set hue, saturation, and lightness; the three formats update automatically without needing to press a button, and the preview appears instantly in your chosen color. Then go to the contrast section to choose the text color, background color, and text size, and press the check button, and the exact contrast ratio will appear along with whether normal and large text meet the requirements. These results help you choose readable, eye-friendly colors for websites, apps, and posts.

Which formats does the tool support?
The tool supports the three common formats: HEX, RGB, and HSL. Enter a value in any field and the other two formats and the preview will update automatically with no extra steps.
How is the contrast ratio calculated?

Relative luminance is calculated for each color according to WCAG, then the larger value is divided by the smaller after adding 0.05. The higher the result, the more legible the text is against the background.
What is the difference between AA and AAA?

Level AA requires a ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text, while level AAA requires 7:1 for normal text and 4.5:1 for large text. The tool shows a pass or fail result for each level separately.
Are colors sent to any server?
No. All calculations are performed in your browser using local JavaScript, and there is no connection to any network or external service.
